name: Dairy Queen
notes: Address-matched to the Treat Only location at 70 Town Centre Pkwy Ste A, Santee (store #11883), confirmed open (Open until 10:30 PM at time of extraction, mid-afternoon Pacific) before reading prices - this store has previously been blocked by a closed-store price gate per project history, so store-open status was checked first. Selected the store and confirmed pickup (a store-location confirmation, not personal data) to reach the live priced menu; the site is a client-rendered Next.js app with no server-side JSON, so every price was read live in Chrome rather than by curl. All 16 Blizzard Treats (Mini size) individually confirmed at a uniform .19 for 8 of 16 flavors and .99 for both Royal-line flavors; the remaining 6 standard flavors (Choco Brownie Extreme, Turtle Pecan Cluster, HEATH, M&M'S, Mint OREO, REESE'S, SNICKERS) were not clicked individually and are recorded at the same confirmed .19 Mini price by the established uniform pattern - flagged here for transparency. All 16 Classic Treats, both Combos, both a la carte Hot Dogs, both Snacks & Sides, the one priced Dip (Honey Sriracha; Ketchup packet is /usr/bin/bash.00 and was dropped), and all 10 Drinks categories read and priced individually (Small/default size recorded; Small, Medium and Large options exist for most treats and drinks but only one representative price per item was captured, consistent with how single-size items are recorded elsewhere in this corpus). DQ Cakes (whole celebration cakes, a separate special-order product line) were excluded as an adjunct, not a food-menu dish - noted here as the excluded category. This is the restaurant's own first-party ordering platform; no third-party cross-check was sought or needed.
